backfill_news.headline: EPA Updates Sustainable Management of Food Guidance
backfill_news.summary: EPA guidance page updated on sustainable food waste management, including the Wasted Food Scale based on research on environmental impacts of food waste management pathways and methane emissions from landfilled food waste.
